endpoints.name: Create Account Transfer Sub Header

idempotency.notes: Not idempotent; a duplicate check exists so repeating usually fails with a conflict/validation message

It validates the request, then checks for an existing/duplicate record, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IAccountTransferSubHeader.GetAccountTransferMainHeaderById, IAccountTransferSubHeader.IsAccountTransferSubHeaderDuplicateAsync, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: AccountTransferSubHeader: INSERT, AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid data provided. [when !ModelState.IsValid]; Sub header name is required.
